newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Institutions oversuscribe MOL shrs 44 times.
newsitem.headline: Institutions oversuscribe MOL shrs 44 times.

text.p: Hungarian institutional investors oversubscribed 44 times a two percent stake in oil company MOL's domestic public offer, market sources said on Thursday.
The institutions lodged subscriptions for 87.8 million shares while only 1.97 million were on offer.
The sources added that domestic retail investors bidding for another two percent, or 1.97 million shares, with a right to buy up to 500 shares each, applied for 5.87 million shares.
Hungary's privatisation agency APV Rt offered a total four percent stake to domestic investors in a public offer, with two percent or 1.97 million shares to retailers and institutions each.
The public offer followed a six-times oversubscribed private placement in MOL shares.
APV placed 12.5 percent in MOL privately, giving an over-allotment option of 2.5 percent for the joint global co-ordinators.
The size of the domestic subscription means that investors who are not MOL employees could only be allocated between 30 and 40 shares, the sources said.
They added that most retail investors subscribed using the deferred payment facilities.
